notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 release
notes.content:
The patch v1.0.2 has just been released, please find the changelog below:

Balance Changes

Enemies now spawn 6% faster for all levels.
All enemy spaceships will now move 1% faster per level, up to a maximum of +30% movement speed.
Solar Ray enemy types will now cast their Laser Focus ability 5% more often and the damage of Laser Focus is increased by 32%.
Increased the damage of Specter's missiles by 13%.
Increased the damage of illusionist's missiles by 15%.
Increased the damage of Vanguard's missiles by 25%.
Increased the damage of Freezer's missiles by 10%.
Increased the damage of Mothership's missiles by 30%.
If there is no empty slot at the ground, new Boosters will now normally spawn and will hover for 5 seconds before they fly away if not used.
Vault Keepers will now fly away after 10 seconds, down from 15 seconds.
Specter enemy types will now cast their Invisibility 20% more often.
Freezer enemy types will now cast their Ice Shard ability 7% more often.
Medics will now cast their Electrozap ability 10% more often.


Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where sometimes after Time Distortion enemies wouldn't reset to their normal animation speed.
Fixed a bug that was causing Weapons to sometimes fire at the wrong direction under rare conditions.
Fixed a bug with Level Up, where sometimes Boosters would not spawn correctly.
Fixed a rare bug that was causing Boosters to stack beyond their allowed capacity.
Fixed an issue with Boosters that could jump to wrong locations under rare conditions.
Fixed a bug that was causing Boosters to sometimes come out of a Black Hole.
Fixed a bug for the active Base indicator, that sometimes was appearing on wrong positions if a Base was destroyed.
Minor interface fixes for some GUI buttons and panels.


Interface

Scores at the Leaderboards are now displayed using comma separators for values above a thousand. 
Added a new GUI button at the Main Menu for easier access to the game's Steam store page. This button will appear after you play at least 3 rounds.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 release
notes.content:
The patch v1.0.1 has just been released, please find the changelog below:

Balance Changes

Specter types now cast their Invisibility 20% more often.
Demolisher enemy types will acquire a target 10% faster after they appear.
Reduced the Teleport cooldown of the illusionist enemy type by 45%.
Enemies after level 25 will now spawn 13% faster.


Bug fixes

Fixed an issue that prevented the completion of OmniSCIENCE and Galactic Mayhem achievements.
Fixed a bug that caused the bonus multiplier text to sometimes appear on top of other GUI text.
Fixed a bug that caused in-game tips to sometimes ignore the setting to not display them.


Interface

Added a button at the Main Menu for easier access to Rankings. 
Added support for non-english text characters at the Leaderboards.

notes.title: Pre-release Development Update
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders,

We hope that you are ready to defend Earth, as after a long journey we had, we will be able to launch Galactic Missile Defense during  Q1 of 2017  (initial plan was Q4 of 2016). We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delayed launch, many things happened that we could not have predicted, but the game is almost ready to be released and will do so later this year after we ensure that we have the proper time to support the post-launch with quick updates. 

In the meanwhile you can practice your skills at the mobile version of the game and be sure to stay tuned for our release announcement. You can also follow us on Facebook and as always please feel free to send us suggestions via email, so we can develop the best version possible for Steam, thank you! ːsteamhappyː

Edit:  The game was aimed to be released during Q4 of 2016 but we decided to move the release towards Q1 of 2017. This is because we would like to ensure a smooth launch and the best experience for you. Stay tuned for more updates!  ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello Commanders,

We are working around the clock to improve the game and develop a great version for Steam, hence the slight delay with our launch. We aim to release Galactic Missile Defense during the next month, as we are doing many improvements and do not want to just port the mobile version.

The game will work across all three platforms that Steam supports and after the launch we will be watching and discussing with our community, to add more features and provide frequent content updates.

Make sure to follow the game and stay tuned for the release date. We will do our best to complete the final Steam version as soon as possible, until then please feel free to continue providing your valuable feedback.

Thank you!
